themes.Scope: Population scale and composition; demographic change; household and social vulnerability; human development and community context.
themes.Illustrative Subthemes: Population scale & density; Population dynamics & migration; Age & dependency; Household structure; Poverty/indigence/inequality; Education & skills; Vulnerable populations; Housing/social pressure
themes.V3 Rationale: Preserve the original Demographic Complexity concept while broadening it to the social conditions that materially shape municipal demand and support need.
themes.Consultation Status: Proposed V3 foundation – open to evidence-based consultation change

themes.Scope: Political-administrative stability; leadership; planning; accountability; compliance; organisational capability; human resources; systems; participation and responsiveness.
themes.Illustrative Subthemes: Political/council stability; Administrative leadership; Planning & performance; Legislative compliance; Assurance/risk; Human resources & skills; Institutional systems; Public participation; Responsiveness; IGR/dependencies
themes.V3 Rationale: Combines governance conditions with the institutional capability required to manage municipal complexity. Digital/data capability is a cross-cutting lens anchored here.
themes.Consultation Status: Proposed V3 foundation – open to evidence-based consultation change

themes.Scope: Municipal functions, service access, affordability, reliability, quality, infrastructure condition, maintenance and delivery performance.
themes.Illustrative Subthemes: Water; Sanitation/wastewater; Electricity; Solid waste; Roads; Stormwater; Fire/emergency; Municipal health; Public transport/NMT; Community facilities; Parks/recreation; Markets/abattoirs; Service affordability; Reliability/quality; Infrastructure investment & maintenance
themes.V3 Rationale: The original LG complexity framework is functionally broad. This theme must cover the full municipal service-function universe, not only water/electricity/finance.
themes.Consultation Status: Proposed V3 foundation – open to evidence-based consultation change

themes.Scope: Local economic structure, opportunity, vulnerability, labour market, investment, business environment and municipal economic-development conditions.
themes.Illustrative Subthemes: Employment & labour; GVA/productivity; Economic growth & structure; Investment; Household economy; Business environment/red tape; Economic nodes/property economy; Informal economy/street trading; Tourism; Agriculture/mining/sector dependency
themes.V3 Rationale: Retains economic development as a broad municipal-condition theme and accommodates both hard economic data and separately-governed business-perception evidence.
themes.Consultation Status: Proposed V3 foundation – open to evidence-based consultation change

themes.Scope: Municipal fiscal viability, revenue strength, liquidity, budget implementation, assets, expenditure discipline, audit and financial governance.
themes.Illustrative Subthemes: Revenue & collection; Debtors; Creditors/liabilities; Liquidity/cash; Budget implementation; Grants/dependency; Capital investment; Asset management; Repairs/maintenance; SCM/expenditure; Audit; UIFW expenditure; Financial distress/recovery
themes.V3 Rationale: Finance is a primary theme, but Financial Management can also operate as a cross-cutting lens where financial capability affects service and institutional performance.
themes.Consultation Status: Proposed V3 foundation – open to evidence-based consultation change

themes.Scope: Spatial form, settlement pattern, accessibility, land use, housing, environment, climate exposure, resource resilience and disaster risk.
themes.Illustrative Subthemes: Settlement form & dispersion; Rurality/urbanisation; Informal settlements; Land use & SDF; Housing/spatial pressure; Accessibility/remoteness; Environmental condition; Water/resource security; Climate exposure & vulnerability; Disaster/fire risk; Adaptation/resilience
themes.V3 Rationale: Climate and climate resilience remain highly visible and deep, but are nested here because they interact directly with spatial planning, settlements, infrastructure, water, environment and disaster resilience.
themes.Consultation Status: Proposed V3 foundation – open to evidence-based consultation change

screens.Purpose: Explain the single analytical pipeline before any consultation edits.
screens.Context: Global model; no municipal selection required
screens.Primary UI Content: Pipeline diagram; six broad themes; layer model; theme-admission test; worked climate example
screens.Guardrail: No indicator/theme editing before orientation acknowledgement.

screens.Purpose: Create the governed consultation context and participants.
screens.Context: Province required; district/municipality optional at start
screens.Primary UI Content: Province; session date; facilitator; specialist areas; participant list; objectives; model version
screens.Allowed User Actions: Create session; add participant; assign role; set scope
screens.Guardrail: Session cannot proceed without province, facilitator, date and model version.

screens.Purpose: Show the province as a portfolio of distinct municipalities rather than a single average.
screens.Bound Governed Sources: Layer 0 structural profile source; 24_MANDATE_FUNCTION_MAP; future live municipal master
screens.Primary UI Content: Municipalities by category/MIIF; district areas; functions; population/budget scale; key structural descriptors
screens.Allowed User Actions: Filter by category/district/function; select municipality; open peer set
screens.Guardrail: District municipality and district-area aggregation must be distinct objects.

screens.Purpose: Establish who/what the municipality is before judging performance.
screens.Primary UI Content: Category; metro/local/district; MIIF; powers/functions; WSA/WSP; electricity function; land area; settlement/economic typology
screens.Allowed User Actions: Inspect source; challenge structural fact; compare peer
screens.Guardrail: Function not performed = N/A, never zero or poor performance.

screens.Purpose: Make atomic evidence visible before indicator discussion.
screens.Primary UI Content: 305 raw data points with source owner/system, period, geography, quality status and missing-data rule
screens.Allowed User Actions: Search; filter; inspect lineage; drag data point into indicator builder; raise source/data challenge
screens.Guardrail: Calculated indicators are not raw data points; missing and N/A remain distinct.

screens.Purpose: Show exactly how an indicator is built from raw inputs and why it matters.
screens.Context: Municipality + indicator or selected data points
screens.Primary UI Content: Definition; diagnostic question; numerator; denominator; formula; unit; direction; frequency; source; quality checks; mandate; controllability
screens.Allowed User Actions: Inspect; assemble draft indicator from data points; edit proposed definition; compare existing match
screens.Guardrail: No workshop edit overwrites the baseline contract directly.

screens.Purpose: Test whether the indicator deserves entry into the model before discussing weight.
screens.Primary UI Content: Relevance; source; data availability; municipal applicability; duplication; direction; controllability; analytical value
screens.Allowed User Actions: Accept for consultation; challenge; reject; request evidence; mark duplicate/merge
screens.Guardrail: Weight and threshold controls remain disabled until validity gate passes.

screens.Purpose: Retain specialist granularity at the appropriate hierarchical level.
screens.Primary UI Content: Indicator card; candidate subthemes; current home; related indicators; duplicate warning
screens.Allowed User Actions: Drag indicator to subtheme; create proposed subtheme; add secondary link
screens.Guardrail: Moving an indicator never silently changes its source contract or scoring state.

screens.Purpose: Test whether a subtheme belongs under one of the six broad themes.
screens.Primary UI Content: Six themes; subtheme clusters; theme scope; overlap heat/duplicate warning
screens.Allowed User Actions: Drag subtheme to theme; challenge current parent; request rename/merge/split
screens.Guardrail: New standalone theme triggers the admission test; importance alone is not sufficient.

screens.Purpose: Expose specialist areas across themes without multiplying top-level themes.
screens.Primary UI Content: HR/skills; digital/data; compliance; political/IGR; citizen outcomes; climate/resilience; financial-management tags
screens.Allowed User Actions: Add/remove proposed lens tag; inspect all indicators carrying lens
screens.Guardrail: Lens is not a second scoring theme by default; duplicate scoring warning shown.

screens.Purpose: Give specialists a fair, evidence-based route to propose a new theme.
screens.Primary UI Content: 10 admission criteria; existing parent coverage; proposed subthemes; data universe; unique decision use; double-count risk
screens.Allowed User Actions: Score evidence against criteria; attach evidence; submit architecture challenge
screens.Guardrail: No theme is created during the session; workshop decision and governance approval are separate states.

screens.Purpose: Demonstrate that deep specialist coverage does not require standalone-theme status.
screens.Primary UI Content: Flood; drought; heat; wildfire; water security; adaptation; resilient settlements; stormwater/fire links
screens.Allowed User Actions: Explore; trace cross-theme links; launch theme challenge if participant disagrees
screens.Guardrail: Must show all climate evidence retained; never frame nesting as de-prioritisation.

screens.Purpose: Test proposed indicator/mapping against real municipal variation and peer groups.
screens.Bound Governed Sources: Future live municipal values bound to 12_INDICATOR_CONTRACT; Layer 0 peer grouping
screens.Primary UI Content: Raw values; source period; peer distribution; missingness; false positive/negative examples
screens.Allowed User Actions: Compare peers; flag anomaly; test interpretation; attach specialist explanation
screens.Guardrail: No simple metro-vs-rural comparison without peer/category context.

screens.Purpose: Show how municipal evidence becomes district/provincial intelligence without hiding variation.
screens.Bound Governed Sources: 12_INDICATOR_CONTRACT roll-up rules; future live municipal values
screens.Primary UI Content: Municipal distribution; direct district municipality profile; district-area aggregation; province distribution; severe-tail municipalities
screens.Allowed User Actions: Change view; inspect numerator/denominator aggregation; challenge roll-up method
screens.Guardrail: Never simple-average ratios/percentages unless method explicitly requires it.

screens.Purpose: Prevent the workshop from conflating structural complexity, municipal capability, performance and support need.
screens.Primary UI Content: Four distinct dimensions: structural complexity; capability/maturity; performance/risk; support need
screens.Allowed User Actions: Filter evidence by dimension; inspect drivers; challenge role classification
screens.Guardrail: One number must not hide contradictory underlying dimensions.

screens.Purpose: Connect municipal evidence to what SALGA/partners should actually do.
screens.Bound Governed Sources: Layer 5 support response; 23_V4_PIPELINE_CONTROL; future support taxonomy
screens.Primary UI Content: Support intensity; specialist disciplines; multidisciplinary need; partner/sector department; provincial office resource implications
screens.Allowed User Actions: Propose support response; tag stakeholder; compare need portfolio
screens.Guardrail: Capacity building is an intervention, not a municipal-condition theme.

screens.Purpose: Make every consultation input traceable and prevent verbal decisions from disappearing.
screens.Primary UI Content: All proposals/challenges/evidence requests/decisions; before/after; participant; rationale; evidence; status
screens.Allowed User Actions: Filter; comment; set workshop decision; assign evidence owner
screens.Guardrail: Baseline model is not mutated by a decision row.

screens.Purpose: Produce the province's formal consultation outputs and unresolved work.
screens.Primary UI Content: Agreed changes; rejected proposals; evidence requests; source/data gaps; unresolved theme challenges; support implications; model delta
screens.Allowed User Actions: Generate output package; mark session complete
screens.Guardrail: Session cannot close with unowned evidence requests unless explicitly deferred.
